statusMeaning: confirmed means an entry derived from the pinned Unicode CLDR source. This country/territory label does not establish a product’s origin.
derivation: CLDR 48.0.0; canonical = ru territory display name; aliases = en display name, alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, and CLDR ru/en alt names; aliases equivalent under normalizer v1 are removed.
selection: Two-letter mappings with numeric codes 001–899 and display names present in both ru and en. This produces 249 ISO 3166-1 countries and territories. Historical codes without current display names, reserved/special 9xx codes, macroregions and CLDR-only territories are excluded.
directionsMeaning: Empty list: country/territory is universal across retail directions.
